findings.title: Default security context configured
findings.message: deployment api in shop namespace is using the default security context, which allows root privileges
findings.resolution: To enhance security, it is strongly recommended not to rely on the default security context. Instead, it is advisable to explicitly define the required security parameters (such as runAsNonRoot, capabilities, readOnlyRootFilesystem, etc.) within the security context.
